Mandarin Oriental, Milan is looking for a Director of Commercial Strategy to join our Sales team. Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional. Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group is the award-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting-edge of luxury experiences. Ideally located on the charming Via Andegari, Mandarin Oriental, Milan is a stylish and intimate hotel, featuring 104 guestrooms, including 36 beautifully appointed suites. Set in the heart of the city, only steps away from the world-renowned La Scala opera house, it inhabits four elegant 18th Century buildings in Milan's most prestigious district. Guests can discover exquisite dining in the beautiful setting of two-Michelin-starred restaurant Seta, run by acclaimed chef Antonio Guida, and enjoy the relaxed atmosphere of the Mandarin Garden, where an eclectic choice of contemporary cuisine and cocktails are offered in chic surroundings. The Spa at Mandarin Oriental, Milan is the city's most comprehensive, offering a holistic approach to rejuvenation and relaxation in tranquil, meditative surroundings that feature indoor swimming pool and six private treatment rooms. About The Job The Director of Commercial Strategy is responsible for leading the hotel’s sales function and driving revenue growth across all segments (Rooms, F&B, Spa, Events). This role plays a key part in shaping the commercial success of the property and strengthening its market presence in the Italian competitive luxury hospitality sector. As Director of Commercial Strategy, you will responsible for the following duties: Lead all revenue-generating functions—including Sales, Marketing, and Revenue Management—to drive business growth, optimise profitability, and ensure full alignment with market trends and brand positioning. Develop and implement the hotel’s integrated commercial strategy and overall business outlook in line with brand and global commercial guidelines. Prepare the annual sales budget, marketing plan, and commercial forecasts in collaboration with Revenue and Marketing teams. Leverage data and market intelligence to monitor trends, competitor activities, and local/global events, proactively adjusting commercial strategies to capture demand and address evolving market needs. Identify future revenue opportunities across segments, channels, and source markets through structured competitive, trend, and channel analysis; translate insights into actionable plans with clear KPIs. Drive a culture of collaboration and joint accountability across Sales, Revenue, Marketing, and operational teams to deliver commercial performance. Collaborate with the Director of Revenue to define pricing, inventory controls, segmentation, channel distribution, and source-market strategies in line with corporate guidelines. Define and oversee sales strategies, ensuring alignment with Regional Sales Offices, Corporate Revenue Management, Marketing & Communications, and on-property leadership. Evaluate the effectiveness of all sales channels, optimise sales deployment, and ensure budgets are allocated to maximise ROI. Lead the implementation of event-specific revenue strategies and ensure timely processing of reservation inquiries to capture all potential demand. Partner with Marketing & Communications to design targeted campaigns and promotional initiatives that support the hotel’s commercial objectives. Ensure consistent brand messaging across all channels and leverage digital platforms to drive awareness and conversion. Review and analyse campaign results, adjusting future plans to improve effectiveness and competitiveness. Demonstrate strong business acumen by analysing financial statements, revenue reports, and market data to identify risks, opportunities, and performance gaps. Oversee the tracking and reporting of key commercial metrics such as booking pace, market share, and competitor performance. Embed structured governance processes to identify risks and opportunities, present insights during monthly forums, and lead the delivery of action plans to meet annual targets. Control commercial expenditures through monthly forecasts and ensure adherence to approved budgets. Ensure effective use of commercial systems—including SynXis, IDeaS, and Delphi—to support strategy execution and accurate reporting. Ensure commercial operations comply with all Mandarin Oriental policies and procedures. Perform any other reasonable duties as required by the General Manager. As Director Of Commercial Strategy, We Expect From You A minimum of 7+ years of senior sales experience within luxury hospitality, including at least 3 years in a leadership role managing teams and key accounts. Demonstrated success in driving revenue growth, achieving commercial targets, and improving performance across multiple segments and channels. Strong leadership and cross-functional collaboration capabilities, with the ability to guide Sales, Marketing, Revenue Management, and Distribution teams. High level of business acumen and strategic thinking, with the ability to anticipate market trends, adapt rapidly, and translate insights into actionable commercial plans. Strong command of written and spoken English and Italian. Proficiency with hotel commercial systems such as SynXis, IDeaS, Delphi, and related analytical and reporting tools. Ability to manage multiple complex projects and commercial priorities in a fast-changing environment. Our Commitment To You Learning & Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously. MOstay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the #MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones. Heath & Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. Segnala offerta di lavoro GoWit is a fast-growing AdTech company building the next generation of Retail Media technology. Our omnichannel Retail Media solutions help retailers monetize their advertising inventory and enable brands and advertisers to reach shoppers across on-site, off-site, and in-store channels. With GoWit Edge, our enterprise Retail Media platform, and GoWit One, our AI-powered commerce and retail media operating system, we’re helping shape the future of commerce advertising. Segnala offerta di lavoro Company Overview: Flowserve is a global manufacturer of pumps, valves, seals, and aftermarket services, delivering comprehensive flow control solutions that support essential industries such as energy, clean water, and pharmaceuticals. If you're looking for a culture built on ingenuity, innovation, and excellence, Flowserve offers the opportunity to put your experience in motion. Whether you're an individual contributor or a people leader, you'll find meaningful opportunities for professional growth, competitive rewards, and a workplace grounded in our core values: People, Safety, Integrity, Ownership and Ingenuity. At Flowserve, we're inspired by what we can achieve together—creating extraordinary flow control solutions that strengthen today's world while building tomorrow. Your Role and Impact The Product Manager Blakeborough Control Valves is responsible for the overall strategy, growth, lifecycle management, and financial performance of Blakeborough Control Valves on a global basis. Acting as the business owner for the product portfolio, this role drives market growth, profitability, innovation, and strategic execution across the organization. Rather than focusing solely on technical product expertise, the Product Manager approaches the product portfolio as an independent business—developing and deploying product strategy, capturing customer insights, prioritizing initiatives, leading commercialization efforts, and aligning cross-functional teams to achieve business objectives. The role reports to the Product Line Leader for Linear Control Valves. Key Responsibilities Product Strategy & Financials: Own, drive and execute the 5-yr Product strategy & roadmap, as well as financial performance of the respective product(s) – bookings, revenue & gross profit. Lifecycle Management: manage the entire product lifecycle, from business case and product development to end-of-life and execute CORE 80/20 actions for portfolio optimization. Business Growth & Go-to-Market strategy: Develop and execute comprehensive go-to-market strategies to increase market share and grow revenue— analyzing market trends, competitor positioning, margin performance, pricing dynamics, and sales channels. Voice of Customer (VOC) & Innovation Excellence: Conduct VOC research to identify market needs, outline strategic product roadmaps, and translate customer requirements into product initiatives and commercial priorities. Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration: Partner with global manufacturing, engineering, operations, and commercial teams to align product strategy, supply, operational execution, and portfolio performance. Project & Timeline Execution: Work within structured, timeline-driven project frameworks to execute strategic initiatives, product enhancements, and market launch plans. Data & Performance Analytics: Utilize advanced Excel data modeling and Power BI analytics to track portfolio metrics, sales funnels, and distribution performance. Key Requirements Strong market-led and customer-driven mindset. Emotionally intelligent leader and collaborator with ability to influence team members at all levels of the organization, solve complex problems, and resolve conflicts. Clear communicator and “storyteller”, with “executive presence” and ability to communicate effectively to senior leadership. Ability to navigate a complex global organization. Strong prioritization skills and sense of urgency, as well as good time management with ability to effectively work with people in different time zones. Results-driven mindset with eagerness to embrace and drive accountability. Innovative mindset, with eagerness to cultivate “outside-the-box” thinking across the team. Strength in leading go-to-market commercialization efforts. Qualifications & Experience Experience: 8 to 10+ years of progressive experience in product management, commercial strategy, product specialization, or technical sales within industrial valve or fluid control markets. Domain Expertise: Exposure to valve manufacturing or industrial fluid motion systems. Industry Background: Proven track record across the following global industries: Power , LNG, Nuclear, Chemical, and Oil & Gas sectors. Strategic Business Acumen: Strong ability to manage market strategy, financial modeling, and growth plans. Customer Interaction: Proven track record of direct customer engagement, VOC gathering, and commercial channel support. Technical & Analytical Tools: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel/Powerpoint ; experience interacting with or interpreting Power BI dashboards. Global Exposure: Ability to collaborate effectively across global teams, diverse cultural environments, and multiple time zones. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Marketing, or a related technical discipline. We want to provide our team with the right resources to invest in your physical, mental and financial well-being no matter where you sit or what stage of life you're in. Per una solida realtà, filiale italiana di un gruppo multinazionale leader mondiale nello sviluppo, nella produzione e nella commercializzazione di componenti, apparecchi e sistemi per la ventilazione e la climatizzazione degli ambienti , ricerchiamo una figura di INTERNAL SALES & CRM SPECIALIST. L'azienda combina il know-how di una grande multinazionale con la dinamicità di una struttura snella, offrendo un ambiente collaborativo e fortemente orientato al supporto reciproco. IL RUOLO Avrai un ruolo centrale di raccordo tra la forza vendita esterna, l'ufficio ordini e i clienti, contribuendo al contempo all'ottimizzazione dei processi commerciali e del CRM aziendale. Ti occuperai di: Gestire le richieste di offerta provenienti dai clienti e dagli Area Manager, elaborando preventivi tecnico-economici. Monitorare l'avanzamento delle offerte inviate dal team commerciale, garantendo un follow-up tempestivo per massimizzare il tasso di conversione in ordini. Verificare la congruenza tecnica e commerciale degli ordini ricevuti rispetto alle offerte emesse. Mantenere costantemente aggiornato il CRM aziendale ed essere il punto di riferimento interno per il suo utilizzo. Elaborare report periodici sulle performance di vendita (per famiglia di prodotto, area geografica, ecc.) a supporto dell'ottimizzazione dei processi. Collaborare con il team Marketing di casa madre per l'allineamento sulle iniziative commerciali. CHI CERCHIAMO Esperienza min. 1-2 anni in ruoli analoghi, maturati in realtà di prodotto. Non è indispensabile la provenienza dal settore HVAC, ma lo è la curiosità e la volontà di comprendere il prodotto tecnico. Competenze informatiche: Buona padronanza del Pacchetto Office e dimestichezza con i principali gestionali CRM (la conoscenza di Microsoft Dynamics costituisce un plus). Costituisce un valore aggiunto l'interesse verso l'uso dei social e dell'AI. Conoscenza della lingua inglese , sia scritta che parlata, per interfacciarsi con la casa madre. Spiccate doti relazionali, comunicative e forte orientamento al cliente . Approccio analitico, precisione, ottime capacità organizzative nella gestione delle priorità, attitudine al problem solving e predisposizione al lavoro in team (a stretto contatto con Vendite, Ufficio Tecnico e Ufficio Ordini). COSA TROVERAI IN AZIENDA Inserimento diretto in una realtà multinazionale solida, strutturata e in continua crescita . Un percorso di formazione tecnica mirata sui prodotti e sui software aziendali. Un ambiente stimolante in cui valorizzare le proprie competenze organizzative e relazionali. Pacchetto retributivo commisurato all'esperienza (38.000 – 40.000 € di RAL). MadeInAdd supporta i clienti industriali lungo l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto: dalla modellazione 3D e prototipazione, fino alla produzione in serie e ai ricambi. Oltre 600 clienti hanno già scelto MadeInAdd per i loro progetti di Additive Manufacturing. Offriamo competenze dedicate in diversi settori tra cui Aerospaziale/Difesa, Automotive, Medicale, Automazione e Robotica, fino ad Arte e Design, combinando avanzate capacità ingegneristiche con un ampio portafoglio di tecnologie, materiali e sfiniture. Nel quadro dell'evoluzione strategica e all'espansione internazionale stiamo potenziando l'organigramma del team Marketing inserendo la figura manageriale di Senior PR, Communication Eventi & International Manager. Sintesi del Ruolo e Livello Manageriale Il/La Senior PR, Communication Eventi & International Manager riferirà direttamente al Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) e avrà la responsabilità dell'area PR Media Comms, Italia + International. La figura eserciterà autonomia nell'elaborazione della roadmap reputazionale e nella proposta di allocazione del budget media e degli eventi con una gestione end-to-end, lavorando a stretto contatto con il CMO e il CEO per elevare la Brand Reputation, guidare la strategia Eventi B2B/Corporate e coordinare l'adattamento della comunicazione sui mercati esteri. Intratterrà le relazioni con gli uffici stampa e giornalisti di settore sia in Italia che all’Estero. Si occuperà di gestire e ottimizzare le attività e i budget delle sponsorizzazioni e la gestione delle stesse, nonchè alle relazioni con gli uffici stampa dei principali clienti Corporate. Responsabilità Principali Global PR & Media Relations: Sviluppo e gestione delle relazioni pubbliche, dell'ufficio stampa internazionale e della reputazione del brand su scala globale. Posizionamento di MadeInAdd presso la stampa finanziaria, business e verticale. Event & Sponsorship Management: Pianificazione, organizzazione ed esecuzione end-to-end di fiere industriali di settore, eventi B2B & Corporate e gestione delle partnership/sponsorship ad alto impatto per l'attrazione e il consolidamento di clienti Enterprise di alto livello. International Expansion & Localization: Coordinamento e adattamento strategico della comunicazione locale per il posizionamento e l'espansione del brand sui nuovi mercati esteri target (Francia, Spagna, UK e DACH). Sinergia Go-To-Market Enterprise: Collaborazione stretta con il CMO e il CEO per generare Quality Lead nel segmento Large Customers attraverso strategie di posizionamento e presenza mediatica top-tier. Sponsorhip management: selezione, gestione e allocazione del budget per le attività di sponsorizzazioni ritenute strategiche per l’azienda Sito istituzionale e Social media: Produzione, aggiornamento e gestione dei contenuti per il sito web aziendale per la parte istituzionale, comunicati stampa etc. coordinamento con il PED social e allineamento dei contenuti, focus su LinkedIn ma anche Meta e YouTube. Requisiti Richiesti & Profilo Manageriale Esperienza & Seniority: Almeno 7-10 anni di esperienza in ruoli di PR, Corporate Communication, Event Management e comunicazione internazionale in aziende B2B Tech / Industriali o agenzie di comunicazione strutturate. Inquadramento: commisurato all’esperienza, profilo con comprovata autonomia gestionale nella definizione della roadmap e nella gestione del budget media/eventi. Network Media & Sponsorship: Solido portafoglio di relazioni con giornalisti, testate business, quotidiani generalisti e stampa di settore; esperienza nella negoziazione di sponsorizzazioni B2B. Lingue & Mobility: Inglese fluente/madrelingua (C2) per la gestione dei mercati esteri; italiano fluente. Disponibilità a trasferte in Italia e all'estero. Sede di lavoro a Milano o Torino in modalità ibrida. Gradita la conoscenza di seconda lingua come francese, tedesco, o spagnolo. Familiarità e interesse con AI tool Presentazioni e comunicazione interna, employee branding Cosa Offriamo Contratto: Assunzione a tempo indeterminato con inquadramento commisurato all'esperienza (CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria). Package retributivo competitivo con quota variabile MBO sui KPI aziendali. Welfare: Assicurazione sanitaria di categoria, piano welfare aziendale, strumenti di lavoro tecnologici, ticket restaurants. Modalità di Lavoro: Modello ibrido (sede di Milano e Torino con flessibilità di lavoro da remoto). Impatto Strategico: Ruolo manageriale di primo piano nello sviluppo Go-To-Market Enterprise e nella crescita internazionale di MadeInAdd. Segnala offerta di lavoro Descrizione dell'azienda Publicis Groupe Fondata nel 1926 da Marcel Bleustein-Blanchet, Publicis Groupe è oggi il primo gruppo di comunicazione al mondo. Presente in Italia a Milano, Torino, Roma e Verona - con oltre 1.500 professionisti - il Gruppo agisce come partner strategico per la crescita dei propri clienti, offrendo un’ampia gamma di competenze e soluzioni integrate nelle aree della creatività, media, produzione e business transformation. Zenith , parte di Publicis Groupe Italia, è The ROI Agency - un posizionamento che adottiamo con orgoglio dal 2005. Nel tempo, abbiamo evoluto il significato stesso di ROI, adattandolo alla crescente complessità del panorama della comunicazione. Oggi, ROI non è solo Return on Investment, ma anche Return on Imagination: esperienze integrate e innovative che ispirano la crescita. Crescita per il business dei nostri clienti, crescita per le nostre persone, crescita per la nostra cultura. Publicis Groupe è l’unico player del settore capace di accompagnare i brand nel loro percorso di trasformazione digitale, ovunque nel mondo. Panoramica La persona, inserita nel ruolo di Global Media Coordination Manager nella sede di Milano entrerà a far parte del team di coordinamento internazionale con l'obiettivo di guidare la gestione media global di un importante cliente del settore luxury e fashion . Il ruolo garantisce l'allineamento tra gli hub centrali e i mercati locali, supervisionando l'implementazione delle strategie media internazionali, assicurando elevati standard qualitativi e contribuendo alla crescita delle performance dei brand attraverso un approccio orientato ai dati, ai processi e alla collaborazione. Responsabilità Coordinamento internazionale e gestione cliente Gestire le attività media globali dei brand assegnati, fungendo da principale punto di riferimento tra il cliente e i mercati internazionali. Garantire la corretta implementazione delle strategie media nei diversi Paesi, assicurando coerenza con gli obiettivi di business e di comunicazione. Costruire e mantenere relazioni solide e di fiducia con i principali stakeholder locali e global. Facilitare il dialogo tra i diversi team coinvolti nel progetto, favorendo una comunicazione efficace e una rapida risoluzione delle criticità. Governance e processi Supervisionare l'esecuzione dei processi operativi e dei workflow internazionali. Assicurare il rispetto delle tempistiche, delle linee guida e dei deliverable definiti a livello global. Coordinare briefing, raccolta input dai mercati, sviluppo delle risposte strategiche e condivisione delle raccomandazioni con il cliente. Pianificazione e performance Supportare lo sviluppo di strategie media omnicanale a livello internazionale. Collaborare con i team di planning, analytics, reporting e performance per identificare opportunità di ottimizzazione. Monitorare investimenti, budget e risultati delle campagne. Analizzare dati e insight per trasformarli in raccomandazioni strategiche e azionabili. Leadership e sviluppo del team Supportare la crescita professionale delle figure più junior attraverso attività di mentoring e affiancamento. Contribuire al miglioramento continuo di processi, strumenti e metodologie di lavoro. Promuovere una cultura di collaborazione e condivisione delle conoscenze tra i mercati. Esperienza consolidata nella gestione di campagne omnichannel, digital e offline. Solida conoscenza dell'ecosistema media internazionale e delle dinamiche di mercato. Esperienza nella gestione di stakeholder globali e nella coordinazione di team multiculturali. Ottime capacità analitiche. Conoscenza di KPI media, strumenti di reporting e misurazione delle performance. Eccellenti competenze organizzative e di project management. Capacità di lavorare efficacemente in contesti complessi caratterizzati da molteplici mercati e fusi orari. Esperienza nel settore luxury, fashion. Interesse e familiarità con strumenti di AI e soluzioni basate sull'intelligenza artificiale applicate ai processi media e marketing. Inglese fluente (livello avanzato); la conoscenza dell'italiano rappresenta un plus. Soft Skills Forte orientamento al cliente. Pensiero strategico e approccio data-driven. Eccellenti capacità relazionali e comunicative. Proattività e spirito di iniziativa. Capacità di gestione delle priorità e problem solving. Collaborazione e capacità di influenzare stakeholder internazionali. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. What You Will Do Are you commercially driven, technically minded and energized by building customer relationships and developing business? As Area Sales Manager for Power and Energy Solutions at Volvo Penta Industrial, you will be responsible for sales of industrial genset engines and power systems across Italy. You will identify commercial opportunities, build long-term partnerships and contribute to the continued growth of Volvo Penta. What will you do? Volvo Penta Industrial provides power and energy solutions for both combustion engine and electrified applications. We serve customers in a wide range of genset customers. As technologies and customer needs evolve, we continuously develop our offering to create long-term value for our customers and partners. As Area Sales Manager for Power and Energy solutions, you will be responsible for developing sales of industrial engines for generator sets across Italy and wider South Europe. You will work closely with the market, translating customer needs and commercial opportunities into sustainable and profitable business. You will build and develop long-term relationships with global OEM partners, identify new business opportunities and support market development. Your responsibilities include commercial negotiations, regional pricing and working together with technical specialists to ensure that we offer the right solutions for our customers. A key part of the role is understanding how market trends, changing technologies and the transition towards electrified solutions affect our customers and business. You will bring market insights back into the organization and collaborate across functions to strengthen our offering and customer value. You will report to the Director Sales Power and Energy Solutions South Europe and travel regularly within the region to meet customers and partners. Who are you? You are commercially minded and relationship-oriented, with a genuine interest in understanding customers and developing business together with others. You are comfortable taking responsibility for your own market while working closely with colleagues and partners across the organization. We Believe You Have A university or bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business or equivalent experience. Proven experience in B2B sales and commercial negotiations. Good technical understanding of diesel engines, electrification and electronic control systems. English is the official working language within our organization, which means you need strong communication skills for both verbally and in writing in Italian and English on a daily basis. Strong communication and relationship-building skills. The ability and willingness to travel regularly within the region. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office is expected. Italian mother tongue. Spanish and French knowledge is a strong plus. Your future Team You will join the Sales Industrial team, consisting of 5 colleagues in Milan and several colleagues in France and Spain. The team is led by the director, who is based in Italy, Milan. In this role, you will mainly travel within the Italy region to visit customers and partners. Occasionally, you will also travel abroad. Ready for the next move? At Volvo Penta, you will have the opportunity to develop business in some of Europe's most technologically advanced and sustainability-focused markets. You will work closely with customers and partners and have a direct influence on our commercial development in the region. You will join a global organization where technology, customer value and long-term relationships go hand in hand. We offer an environment where you can take ownership, develop your expertise and work alongside knowledgeable colleagues across both commercial and technical functions. In line with our commitment to pay transparency and internal equity, the salary range for this position is €45.000 – €65.000 gross annual salary (RAL). Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience, competencies, and overall fit for the role. The total reward package also includes a company car, in line with company policies, and a 10% annual target bonus. The Volvo Group has high ambitions and is at the forefront of the transition towards fossil-free transport. Our mission to make a difference for society and build the world we want to live in requires more than forward-thinking and working with the latest innovations and technologies. We succeed through teamwork, working hard for our customers, listening to one another and building trust. With nearly 100,000 colleagues around the world, we make every customer a winner. Interested? Apply now! Would you like to make this vacancy your next career move? We look forward to receiving your application! We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Who We Are And What We Believe In We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities. Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group . Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. Volvo Penta , a world-leading supplier of engines and complete drive systems for marine and industrial applications, you will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who works with passion, trust each other and embraces change to stay ahead. title: Coach Business Development Manager - Aerospace
motivazione: Il candidato possiede esperienza manageriale in digital sales e marketing con budget fino a €400k e riporto al board, soddisfacendo il requisito di seniority e di gestione di team. Tuttavia, l’offerta richiede specificamente competenze in Aerospace & Defence, con esperienza in vendite tecniche e conoscenza del settore, competenza che non risulta nel CV. Questo gap principale riduce la probabilità di essere chiamato per un colloquio.

Livello retribuzione di base 43.000,00 €/yr - 48.000,00 €/anno Tipi di retribuzione aggiuntivi Bonus annuale Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da ALTEN Elisa Bellini Elisa Bellini ALTEN supporta le strategie di sviluppo dei propri clienti nelle aree dell’innovazione, della R&D e dei sistemi informativi tecnologici. Nato più di 30 anni fa e presente in 30 Paesi, il Gruppo ALTEN si è affermato come leader mondiale nell’ingegneria e nei Servizi IT e leader Europeo per la consulenza nell'industria Life Sciences. Lavoriamo con attori chiave nei settori: Aeronautico &Spaziale, della Difesa & Navale, della Sicurezza, Automobilistico, Ferroviario, dell’Energia, del Life Sciences, Finanziario, del Retail e dei Servizi. Con un fatturato di oltre 4.069 miliardi di euro, abbiamo attualmente più di 57.400 collaboratori in tutto il mondo. In Italia siamo presenti in 13 città lungo tutto il territorio nazionale: Torino, Milano, Gallarate, Brescia, Genova, La Spezia, Modena, Maranello, Bologna, Firenze, Roma, Napoli e Bari. Come Coach Business Development Manager nel team Aerospace & Defence , avrai piena responsabilità su tre ambiti chiave che definiscono il successo di un’impresa: vendite, persone e gestione . L’obiettivo è di far crescere la tua business unit, renderla redditizia e posizionarla come punto di riferimento per i clienti . 3 Attività chiave: 💡 1. Sales: Crea opportunità da zero: identifica nuovi clienti e prospect , comprendi le loro esigenze e proponi soluzioni consulenziali. Negozia e chiudi deal: offerte competitive, contratti vincenti e relazioni a lungo termine. Partecipa alla redazione di proposte commerciali. 👥 2. Human Resources: Gestisci il team Forma e motiva i Business Development Manager per massimizzare le performance e creare una cultura di collaborazione e risultati. Partecipa alla costruzione della tua BU. 💼 3. P&L and Personnel Management: Monitora la gestione finanziaria : Budget, margini e obiettivi di revenue . Sei punto di riferimento del team e dei clienti . Occupati della relazione con i clienti : Fidelizza e fai crescere il portafoglio clienti, garantendo soddisfazione e fedeltà . Compliance e sicurezza : Assicura che ogni attività sia allineata con GDPR e normative, con un occhio di riguardo alla protezione dei dati. 🎯 Chi cerchiamo: Formazione : Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria, Economia o equivalenti . Esperienza come Sales, Business Development o in consulenza tecnica e l’attitudine imprenditoriale e commerciale è ciò che fa la differenza nel settore Aerospace&Defence . Valutiamo positivamente candidature da contesti consulenziali ma valutiamo anche altri percorsi. ✨Soft Skills: Mindset imprenditoriale : Proattività, resilienza e capacità di prendere iniziative. Doti relazionali e comunicative : ti piace vendere, negoziare e ispirare. Obiettivi sfidanti : Non ti accontenti, vuoi sempre di più . Lingue : Inglese fluente (B2/C1) 💎 Cosa offriamo: Gli strumenti per il tuo successo imprenditoriale Contratto a tempo indeterminato con RAL 43.000–48.000€ + bonus 25.000–35.000€ Auto aziendale ad uso promiscuo (carburante e telepass inclusi) + ticket pasto da 8€/giorno Ambiente dinamico e stimolante Crescita meritocratica : Obiettivi chiari, riconoscimenti tangibili. Formazione continua : Training on the job e sessioni online per migliorare le tue skills imprenditoriali. Life Long Learning con corsi tecnici e linguistici per restare sempre competitivo. 🚀 Perché ALTEN? Lavora come un imprenditore , ma con il supporto e la struttura di un’azienda solida . Fai la differenza ogni giorno, con impatto diretto sul business . Cresci verticalmente: in ALTEN, il tuo successo è il nostro successo . 📩 Invia la tua candidatura e inizia a costruire il tuo futuro in ALTEN! La retribuzione annua lorda per questo ruolo è compresa tra 43.000 EUR e 50.000 EUR + bonus e benefit. Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. In presenza di profili con caratteristiche eccezionali rispetto al range indicato, una revisione potrà essere valutata previa approvazione interna. La posizione è inquadrata nell’ambito del CCNL del Commercio e Terziario applicato da ALTEN. ALTEN opera nel rispetto dei principi di diversità, equità ed inclusione, che alimentano i nostri valori. ALTEN ha l’obiettivo di abbattere ogni barriera e pregiudizio, garantendo un ambiente di lavoro accessibile ed accogliente, valutando candidature indipendentemente da genere, etnia, disabilità (artt. 1 e 18, legge 68/99), età, orientamento sessuale, religione, stato civile, convinzioni personali e politiche, appartenenza ad organizzazioni sindacali, responsabilità familiari e back-ground socio-economico. Segnala offerta di lavoro About The Role We are seeking a highly strategic and well-connected Demand Partnerships Director to lead our agency and demand-side business in Italy. This is not a standard sales role; it is a "Market Maker" position. You will be responsible for elevating Equativ’s market perception, leveraging your personal credibility and "Trust" to secure long-term partnerships, and driving the exponential growth of both our Curation (Equativ Maestro) and premium Managed Service businesses. Reporting to the Managing Director, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening and expanding our Managed Service offering (acquiring new business) alongside our scalable curation solutions, deeply integrating Equativ into the core buying strategies of major HoldCos, independent agencies, and direct brands. Key Responsibilities Strategic Deal Making (JBPs): Lead the negotiation, structuring, and execution of upfront Trading Agreements and Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with major HoldCos (e.g., GroupM, Dentsu, Publicis, OMG) and independent agencies to secure predictable revenue and increase our share of wallet. Curation (Equativ Maestro) & SPO Evangelism: Drive the top-down adoption of Equativ Maestro. Evangelize Supply Path Optimization (SPO) strategies to Chief Investment Officers and Heads of Trading, shifting agency budgets to our high-margin curated deals. Managed Services New Business: Actively prospect and acquire new business for our premium Managed Service offering, positioning it as a high-value, white-glove solution for direct brands and agencies. Ensure a balanced growth strategy between Curation and Managed Services. Cross-Functional Synergy: Work in tight synergy with the Supply & Publisher Deals team to identify, package, and aggressively monetize exclusive local inventory, first-party data, and emerging CTV opportunities for key demand partners. Revenue Growth: Take ownership of the Italian demand revenue target, focusing on accelerating Programmatic revenue and securing new business across both self-serve and premium white-glove managed service tiers. Market Feedback Loop: Act as the primary feedback loop between the Italian market and Global Product/Tech teams, ensuring our Curation and Product roadmaps align with local agency needs. About You Executive Network: You possess a deep, C-level and senior executive network across Italian HoldCos, Agency Trading Desks (Head of Trading, Chief Investment Officers), and direct brands. You bring a high level of "Trust" and personal credibility to the market. Deal Structuring Expertise: Proven experience in structuring, negotiating, and managing complex commercial deals, volume incentive programs, and retroactive rebates (Trading Agreements). Ad-Tech Fluency: Deep understanding of the programmatic ecosystem, DSP/SSP dynamics, Supply Path Optimization (SPO), Curation business models, and the evolving privacy-first data landscape. Strategic Mindset: You are a strategic thinker who can move beyond selling single campaigns, capable of selling infrastructure, efficiency, and exclusive access to senior agency leadership. Leadership & Drive: You are highly autonomous, resilient, and driven by ambitious growth targets, comfortable navigating a fast-paced and evolving ad-tech environment. Language: Native Italian and fluent English are mandatory. What We Offer A pivotal role in scaling a high-growth ad-tech company in the Italian market. A competitive compensation package with a bonus structure heavily weighted towards the successful execution of long-term strategic deals (JBPs) and net revenue growth. Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide. Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients. The Opportunity: The Area Business Lead is responsible for the team promoting Revolution Medicines products/services to the oncology community in the Northern area of Italy. This person is ultimately accountable for building, leading, inspiring, developing and guiding the activities of 7 Senior Oncology Account Managers (SOAMs) to achieve the objectives. In addition, they are responsible for growing several key business relationships with Area-Level healthcare accounts including major health systems, large practice networks, and Area specific oncologists by developing/executing strategic account plans and maximizing appropriate product utilization, while maintaining strong customer relationships and furthering Revolution Medicines reputation as a leader in Oncology. They possess strong analytical, coaching, collaboration and communications skills, while also having a proven track record of success as a sales leader, building world class teams and launching first in class medicines. The Area Business Lead should have the ability to synthesize high volumes of data to strategically guide their team and optimally collaborate with cross functional matrix partners to drive optimal outcomes and foster an unusually healthy and engaging culture. This position reports directly to the Sr. Director, Commercial, Italy. The Area Business Lead is a key leader driving commercial success within the respective region in the oncology business. Acting as a central enabler of integrated, omnichannel customer interaction, and ensuring that regional execution is closely aligned with the overall strategy and internal functions, this position is working closely with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Marketing, and other functions. Through effective leadership, consistent coaching, and the development of high-performing teams, the Area Business Lead does play a pivotal role in achieving revenue and corporate objectives. Primary responsibilities of the Area Business Lead North, Italy, are summarized below. Recruits and develops a best-in-class sales team, cultivates a culture of exceptional performance, accountability and patient first mentality. Shapes an integrated, customer-centric, and high-performing regional execution strategy. They foster a culture of continuous development, learning agility, and personal accountability within their teams. Designs and implements Area-specific sales strategies that align with brand objectives leveraging deep market insights and customer needs. Combines strategic leadership, coaching, and an entrepreneurial mindset with a deep understanding of the oncology care landscape. In doing so, they take responsibility for regional development, team performance, and the consistent execution of the corporate strategy in the market. Creates and communicates short and long-term vision, strategies and initiatives in alignment with corporate goals and objectives. Drives exceptional team performance by setting clear goals, providing tailored coaching and recognizing and rewarding successful behaviors. Leads the development and alignment to key levers of performance such as quarterly business plans and skill building to ensure top performance. Participates as an active member of the Sales leadership team. Provides input and creative thinking into the strategic planning to address all critical business opportunities and promotional tactics to ensure the field perspective is represented. Acts as a conduit for relevant market information from local, field-based employees to home office leadership, as well as appropriate recommendations for action. Oversees the relationship between Revolution Medicines of key Area accounts leveraging internal resources while also meeting customer goals. Manages all resources within budget. Visibly embodies our corporate Core Values and is dedicated to fostering an energized team culture that is patient and impact-focused. Exercises judgment, integrity, and equitable management practices necessary to guide the day-to-day activities of a diverse cross-section of individuals. Utilizes sales data and analytics to build launch plans, identify growth opportunities, inform strategic decisions and contribute to quarterly business reviews. Ensures that sales staff conduct business in compliance with all Revolution Medicines policies and the highest ethical standards. Develops top talent, by encouraging growth and providing opportunities for exposure. Closely collaborates with the brand marketing team on marketing strategy & tactics, and with commercial training on critical skill-building initiatives. Serves as voice of the customer to stakeholders. Complies with all laws, regulations and policies that govern the conduct of Revolution Medicines staff. Required Skills, Experience and Education: Scientific/commercial degree and 15 years of biopharma industry experience. Preferably 5+ years prior experience leading an oncology sales team. Proven track record of product launch success in the oncology therapeutic space. Proven performer in highly competitive marketplaces. Proven performer in solo-representative selling environments. Demonstrated success operating in small/midsize biotechnology environments. Ability to travel to meetings/training/programs, as necessary, mainly within Italy, up to 60% of time. Proven effectiveness in highly collaborative & cross-functional working environments. Valid driver's license. Must permanently reside in the territory for which they are accountable. Self-directed and able to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. Ability to set priorities and work towards tight timelines. Preferred Skills: Preferably experience in the GI and/or NSCLC oncology space. Experience launching oncology products with companion diagnostics. Expert knowledge of all relevant topics (i.e. marketing, training, market access, business of oncology, distribution, data-acquisition, etc.) to this role. Strong organization, planning, project management, technical and analytical skills. Other related experience (e.g., sales operations, market research, market access, etc.). Ability to work independently to execute strategic and tactical plans under tight timelines. Ability to assemble and lead cross-functional teams toward a shared vision of success. Ability to present ideas effectively to individuals or groups, targeting presentation to the needs of the audience. Outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, a structured approach to tasks and a professional appearance is essential to embody the core values from Revolution Medicines. Flexible team member who can handle ambiguity and evolving priorities in a fast-growing organization embracing a positive attitude towards change, able to operate within agreed financial budgets. Delivers compelling presentations to individuals and groups, adapting messaging to maximize audience engagement. Highly proficient in Microsoft suite including Powerpoint, Excel, Word. Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide. Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients. The Opportunity: The Area Business Lead is responsible for the team promoting Revolution Medicines products/services to the oncology community in the Southern area of Italy. This person is ultimately accountable for building, leading, inspiring, developing and guiding the activities of 7 Senior Oncology Account Managers (SOAMs) to achieve the objectives. In addition, they are responsible for growing several key business relationships with Area-Level healthcare accounts including major health systems, large practice networks, and Area specific oncologists by developing/executing strategic account plans and maximizing appropriate product utilization, while maintaining strong customer relationships and furthering Revolution Medicines reputation as a leader in Oncology. They possess strong analytical, coaching, collaboration and communications skills, while also having a proven track record of success as a sales leader, building world class teams and launching first in class medicines. The Area Business Lead should have the ability to synthesize high volumes of data to strategically guide their team and optimally collaborate with cross functional matrix partners to drive optimal outcomes and foster an unusually healthy and engaging culture. This position reports directly to the Sr. Director, Commercial, Italy. The Area Business Lead is a key leader driving commercial success within the respective region in the oncology business. Acting as a central enabler of integrated, omnichannel customer interaction, and ensuring that regional execution is closely aligned with the overall strategy and internal functions, this position is working closely with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Marketing, and other functions. Through effective leadership, consistent coaching, and the development of high-performing teams, the Area Business Lead does play a pivotal role in achieving revenue and corporate objectives. Primary responsibilities of the Area Business Lead South, Italy, are summarized below. Recruits and develops a best-in-class sales team, cultivates a culture of exceptional performance, accountability and patient first mentality. Shapes an integrated, customer-centric, and high-performing regional execution strategy. They foster a culture of continuous development, learning agility, and personal accountability within their teams. Designs and implements Area-specific sales strategies that align with brand objectives leveraging deep market insights and customer needs. Combines strategic leadership, coaching, and an entrepreneurial mindset with a deep understanding of the oncology care landscape. In doing so, they take responsibility for regional development, team performance, and the consistent execution of the corporate strategy in the market. Creates and communicates short and long-term vision, strategies and initiatives in alignment with corporate goals and objectives. Drives exceptional team performance by setting clear goals, providing tailored coaching and recognizing and rewarding successful behaviors. Leads the development and alignment to key levers of performance such as quarterly business plans and skill building to ensure top performance. Participates as an active member of the Sales leadership team. Provides input and creative thinking into the strategic planning to address all critical business opportunities and promotional tactics to ensure the field perspective is represented. Acts as a conduit for relevant market information from local, field-based employees to home office leadership, as well as appropriate recommendations for action. Oversees the relationship between Revolution Medicines of key Area accounts leveraging internal resources while also meeting customer goals. Manages all resources within budget. Visibly embodies our corporate Core Values and is dedicated to fostering an energized team culture that is patient and impact-focused. Exercises judgment, integrity, and equitable management practices necessary to guide the day-to-day activities of a diverse cross-section of individuals. Utilizes sales data and analytics to build launch plans, identify growth opportunities, inform strategic decisions and contribute to quarterly business reviews. Ensures that sales staff conduct business in compliance with all Revolution Medicines policies and the highest ethical standards. Develops top talent, by encouraging growth and providing opportunities for exposure. Closely collaborates with the brand marketing team on marketing strategy & tactics, and with commercial training on critical skill-building initiatives. Serves as voice of the customer to stakeholders. Complies with all laws, regulations and policies that govern the conduct of Revolution Medicines staff. Required Skills, Experience and Education: Scientific/commercial degree and 15 years of biopharma industry experience. Preferably 5+ years prior experience leading an oncology sales team. Proven track record of product launch success in the oncology therapeutic space. Proven performer in highly competitive marketplaces. Proven performer in solo-representative selling environments. Demonstrated success operating in small/midsize biotechnology environments. Ability to travel to meetings/training/programs, as necessary, mainly within Italy, up to 60% of time Proven effectiveness in highly collaborative & cross-functional working environments. Valid driver's license. Must permanently reside in the territory for which they are accountable. Self-directed and able to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. Ability to set priorities and work towards tight timelines. Preferred Skills: Preferably experience in the GI and/or NSCLC oncology space. Experience launching oncology products with companion diagnostics. Expert knowledge of all relevant topics (i.e. marketing, training, market access, business of oncology, distribution, data-acquisition, etc.) to this role. Strong organization, planning, project management, technical and analytical skills. Other related experience (e.g., sales operations, market research, market access, etc.). Ability to work independently to execute strategic and tactical plans under tight timelines. Ability to assemble and lead cross-functional teams toward a shared vision of success. Ability to present ideas effectively to individuals or groups, targeting presentation to the needs of the audience. Outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, a structured approach to tasks and a professional appearance is essential to embody the core values from Revolution Medicines. Flexible team member who can handle ambiguity and evolving priorities in a fast-growing organization embracing a positive attitude towards change, able to operate within agreed financial budgets. Delivers compelling presentations to individuals and groups, adapting messaging to maximize audience engagement. Highly proficient in Microsoft suite including Powerpoint, Excel, Word. Revolution Medicines takes protection and security of personal data very seriously and respects your right to privacy while using our website and when contacting us by email or phone. We will only collect, process and use any personal data that you provide to us in accordance with our CCPA Notice and Privacy Policy. For additional information, please contact privacy@revmed.com. We are aware of recent recruitment scams in which individuals or organizations falsely represent themselves as being affiliated with Revolution Medicines. These scams may appear as false job advertisements or unsolicited contacts through communication or chat platforms, email, phone, or text message. Please note that Revolution Medicines does not extend unsolicited employment offers and will never ask candidates to provide financial information, purchase equipment, or pay fees as part of the hiring process. All legitimate communication from Revolution Medicines will come from an official @revmed.com email address. If you believe you’ve been contacted by someone impersonating a Revolution Medicines recruiter, please report it to careers@revmed.com so we can share these impersonations with our IT team for tracking and awareness. Role Purpose This role is critical to streamline KA and category management, and drive turnover growth across Italian buying groups. Retail Excellence & Sell‑Out Development Boost sell-out performance via promotion planning, in-store visibility and retail execution standards. Unlock opportunities to improve product positioning, shopper experience and brand exposure. Measure promotion effectiveness and track marketing investment ROI. Align internal and external stakeholders to maximise commercial results. Proven negotiation, stakeholder management and commercial planning capabilities. Strong analytical mindset and confidence working with sales data and KPIs. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills are mandatory. Fluent Italian; professional working proficiency in English. Well organised, self-driven, comfortable prioritising multiple parallel workstreams. Segnala offerta di lavoro Job Description Why This Role Matters We are looking for an Agile Project Manager to join our Product and Digital Transformation practice, supporting Digital and CRM initiatives for the Italian market. This role is suited to someone with experience in Digital delivery and/or CRM operations who is comfortable working with client stakeholders and cross-functional teams. You will help coordinate initiatives, improve ways of working and provide practical advisory support on evolving Digital business priorities, CRM and customer engagement. Where You’ll Make an Impact As PM, you will contribute to the successful delivery of Digital and CRM initiatives, helping client and delivery teams maintain clear priorities, effective coordination and consistent progress. Support digital and CRM delivery Support the coordination and delivery of CRM and Digital initiatives. Coordinate delivery teams to ensure agreed milestones and quality standards are met. Help ensure activities remain aligned with client priorities and expected outcomes. Coordinate stakeholders and teams Work with client stakeholders and internal teams across CRM, Web, Marketing, Operations, Product and Technology. Organize and facilitate meetings, workshops and alignment sessions. Provide structured input and practical advice to clients on Digital business priorities, CRM and customer engagement initiatives. Maintain clear and timely communication across all parties involved. Contribute to continuous improvement Identify opportunities to simplify processes and improve operational efficiency. Support the testing, rollout and adoption of new tools and ways of working. Contribute to a collaborative, pragmatic and delivery-focused team environment. What You’ll Bring To The Team 3+ years of experience in project management, product, Digital transformation, CRM, marketing operations, customer experience or related areas. Experience in project coordination, stakeholder management or Digital delivery activities. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities. Good communication, collaboration and problem-solving skills. Interest in Digital, CRM and customer engagement. Fluent Italian and good working English. Additional Experience We Value Familiarity with project management approaches and collaboration tools. Previous experience in a consulting, agency or client-facing environment is desirable. Additional Information What You ll Get in Return Be at the forefront of digital transformation. "Plugged" into a truly global organization with a start-up mindset. Career growth and training opportunities. A collaborative, agile and diverse regional team. Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family. Generous paid leave and holidays. Wellness program and employee assistance. The gross annual base salary range for this position is €26.000-€32.500. This reflects the range we reasonably expect to pay and excludes variable pay and benefits. Individual pay within the range is determined by objective, non-discriminatory criteria - relevant skills, experience and demonstrated expertise - assessed consistently during the hiring process. The salary range indicated is valid at the time of publication of the job posting; the company reserves the right to update it. Company Description About Publicis Sapient Most companies in the AI era do one of two things: they advise, or they sell you a tool. We do both. Publicis Sapient is a technology company that provides enterprise AI platforms and services, which means we build our own AI platforms and bring the strategists, product thinkers, designers and engineers who make them work inside the world s most complex businesses. It is where people and products shape the future of enterprise, and where your ideas actually reach the organizations that run the world. If you want to question how things are done, learn continuously and do the best work of your career alongside 20,000 people across 28 countries, you re in the right place. Come build with us. Our Commitment to Inclusive Hiring We are committed to fostering and encouraging an inclusive and welcoming environment for everyone and we believe great talent comes from many different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and identities including: race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion and value the diverse experiences, perspectives, and strengths they bring to our teams. If there is anything we can do to make our recruitment process more accessible or comfortable for you, please let us know. We are happy to provide reasonable adjustments throughout the application and interview process. You can contact us anytime at emeahiringteam@publicissapient.com. Your Safety Matters To Us At Publicis Sapient, we are committed to protecting candidates throughout every step of their journey with us. To help you stay safe from recruitment scams, please remember that our recruiters will only ever contact you from a Publicis Sapient email address. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Descrizione dell'azienda Publicis Groupe Fondata nel 1926 da Marcel Bleustein-Blanchet, Publicis Groupe è oggi il primo gruppo di comunicazione al mondo. Presente in Italia a Milano, Torino, Roma e Verona – con oltre 1.500 professionisti – il Gruppo agisce come partner strategico per la crescita dei propri clienti, offrendo un’ampia gamma di competenze e soluzioni integrate nelle aree della creatività, media, produzione e business transformation. Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Digital Campaign Specialist da inserire nella Concessionaria di Pubblicità del nostro Gruppo. Obiettivo del Ruolo La figura sarà il punto di raccordo tecnico-strategico a supporto della rete commerciale. Il suo obiettivo è garantire la perfetta esecuzione delle campagne pubblicitarie, ottimizzandone costantemente l'andamento per raggiungere i KPI contrattualizzati (Impression, Viewability, CTR, ecc.), massimizzando la monetizzazione dell'inventory e risolvendo tempestivamente le anomalie tecniche. Responsabilità Chiave Ottimizzazione e Monitoraggio delle Performance: Analizzare quotidianamente il pacing (andamento dell'erogazione) e le metriche delle campagne. Intercettare anomalie (under-delivery o over-delivery) e intervenire tempestivamente sulle impostazioni di target e prioritizzazione. Al fine di ottimizzare le campagne secondo i KPI concordati con il cliente. Troubleshooting & Debugging Tecnico: Identificare e risolvere i problemi di erogazione dei tag pubblicitari (es. malfunzionamenti dei codici JS, conflitti di pagina). Analizzare e ridurre drasticamente gli errori VAST/VMAP sulle campagne video (es. timeout, wrapper vuoti, formati non supportati). Ottimizzazione della Viewability: Monitorare i livelli di Viewability delle campagne attraverso gli strumenti interni (es. Active View di Google) o tool di terze parti (Moat, IAS). Implementare strategie di ottimizzazione (es. esclusioni di posizionamenti a basse performance, modifiche al lazy loading) per raggiungere i target richiesti dai clienti. Supporto Tecnico alla Rete Commerciale (Pre e Post-Vendita): Pre-vendita: Analizzare la disponibilità dell'inventory (forecasting) e suggerire la configurazione ottimale dei pacchetti commerciali basandosi sullo storico dei clienti e sulle performance del network. Post-vendita: Elaborare la reportistica finale e interpretare strategicamente i KPI per aiutare i commerciali a raccontare il successo della campagna o a proporre efficaci strategie di recoup . Competenze Tecniche richieste Piattaforme Pubblicitarie: Gestione approfondita e quotidiana di Google Ad Manager (GAM) (o Ad Server equivalenti sul mercato). Strumenti di Debugging: Utilizzo avanzato di Google Publisher Console e dei Developer Tools del browser (Chrome DevTools, tab Network/Console) per l'ispezione dei codici GPT (Google Publisher Tags) e delle chiamate di rete. Conoscenza Logiche Video: Familiarità approfondita con l'architettura video programmatic/direct, nello specifico con gli standard VAST / VPAID / SIMID e con le dinamiche di funzionamento dei player video (es. IMA SDK). Metriche e KPI: Padronanza assoluta e capacità di correlazione delle metriche di digital advertising: CPM, CPC, CTR, Viewability, VTR (Video Through Rate). Completano il profilo le seguenti soft skills Ottime doti comunicative e relazionali per interfacciarsi efficacemente con la rete commerciale (traducendo concetti tecnici in opportunità di business). Precisione, attenzione ai dettagli e resistenza allo stress nella gestione di scadenze e pianificazioni concomitanti. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Job Description Why This Role Matters We are looking for a Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer who has hands-on experience to join our CRM and Marketing Automation team. The successful candidate will design, develop and maintain marketing automation solutions within Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement, supporting omnichannel campaigns, advanced personalization and data-driven automated processes. The ideal candidate combines solid technical platform knowledge with the ability to translate marketing and business requirements into efficient, scalable and high-quality solutions. The role works closely with CRM Managers, Campaign Specialists, Data Analysts, Solution Architects and business stakeholders. Where You’ll Make an Impact Develop and maintain responsive email templates using HTML, CSS and AMPscript. Build dynamic content and advanced personalization logic. Configure and manage customer journeys in Journey Builder, including entry sources, decision rules and exit criteria. Develop and monitor automated processes through Automation Studio. Create and manage Data Extensions, data relationships, audiences and advanced segmentation. Write, test and optimize SQL queries for data extraction, transformation and validation. Develop landing pages, forms and preference centers using CloudPages, AMPscript and, where required, Server-Side JavaScript. Support integrations with external systems through REST and SOAP APIs, SFTP and standard connectors. Translate functional and business requirements into technical designs and implementation specifications. Perform testing, debugging and root-cause analysis across journeys, automations, data flows and campaign assets. Support test sends, audience validation, UAT, production deployment and post-launch monitoring. Ensure data accuracy, correct personalization and reliable automation execution. Produce and maintain technical documentation, data mappings, configuration details and operating procedures. Apply development standards and reusable approaches to improve scalability, maintainability and delivery efficiency. What You’ll Bring To The Team Demonstrable hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Content Builder, Contact Builder and Data Extensions. Good knowledge of AMPscript for personalization and data-driven communications. Strong SQL skills for segmentation, data extraction and transformation. Good knowledge of HTML and CSS for responsive email development. Understanding of relational data models and customer data structures. Experience with data imports, file transfers, audience management and scheduled automations. Ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail and quality focus. Ability to manage multiple priorities and activities within agreed deadlines. Good written and spoken English. Additional Experience We Value Working knowledge of other CRM platforms. Experience integrating CRM, CDP, data platforms or third-party systems. Experience in multi-business-unit, multi-brand and multi-country environments. Knowledge of email deliverability, sender authentication, consent management and contact governance best practices. Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Email Specialist. Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Developer Additional Information What You ll Get in Return Involvement in complex and strategic CRM and Marketing Automation programs. Exposure and opportunity to contribute to omnichannel and data-driven initiatives. Collaboration with international teams. Opportunities to grow and develop CRM expertise. A dynamic, structured environment focused on delivering true business impact. The gross annual base salary range for this position is €47.100-€57.000. This reflects the range we reasonably expect to pay and excludes variable pay and benefits. Individual pay within the range is determined by objective, non-discriminatory criteria - relevant skills, experience and demonstrated expertise - assessed consistently during the hiring process. The salary range indicated is valid at the time of publication of the job posting; the company reserves the right to update it. Company Description About Publicis Sapient Most companies in the AI era do one of two things: they advise, or they sell you a tool. We do both. Publicis Sapient is a technology company that provides enterprise AI platforms and services, which means we build our own AI platforms and bring the strategists, product thinkers, designers and engineers who make them work inside the world s most complex businesses. It s where people and products shape the future of enterprise, and where your ideas actually reach the organizations that run the world. If you want to question how things are done, learn continuously and do the best work of your career alongside 20,000 people across 28 countries, you re in the right place. Come build with us. Our Commitment to Inclusive Hiring We are committed to fostering and encouraging an inclusive and welcoming environment for everyone and we believe great talent comes from many different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. That s why we re committed to creating a hiring process where everyone has an equal opportunity to succeed and feel safe. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and identities including: race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion and value the diverse experiences, perspectives, and strengths they bring to our teams. If there s anything we can do to make our recruitment process more accessible or comfortable for you, please let us know. We re happy to provide reasonable adjustments throughout the application and interview process. You can contact us anytime at emeahiringteam@publicissapient.com. Your Safety Matters To Us At Publicis Sapient, we re committed to protecting candidates throughout every step of their journey with us. Backed by the incredible insight of Gartner Research, Gartner Consulting helps the world’s leading organisations stay ahead of the digital curve. From CIOs, to leaders in business and government, we help Gartner clients across enterprises translate insights into transformational actions and achieve their mission-critical priorities. Leveraging the breadth of Gartner’s resources, Consulting is growing rapidly, with unlimited potential to continue expanding our client base. Our Consulting business is trusted by senior leaders (CxO or equivalent) across sectors such as Energy & Utilities, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Retail & Consumer, and Life Sciences & Pharmaceuticals. We help the C-suite make the right decisions based on how technology can transform their businesses. Our multi-disciplinary teams collaborate closely with clients, delivering meaningful outcomes, strengthening capabilities, and building relationships that last. What you’ll do: Forge meaningful relationships: You’ll build trusted relationships with C-level leaders (CEO, CIO, COO, CTO) across top industry clients. You’ll move beyond traditional advising, helping clients rethink challenges, shape their vision, and create space for innovative transformation. Your guidance will empower them to tackle their biggest priorities with confidence. Lead the Consulting Lifecycle: You’ll design and deliver strategies that spark new opportunities and bring fresh solutions to life. From initial client discussions to collaborating with diverse teams to build compelling proposals, you’ll be hands-on in helping clients achieve real, measurable impact. Your insight and creativity will be valued at every stage - your voice matters here. Shape our Future Together: Our business grows through the strengths and perspectives of our people. You’ll play a key role in developing new offerings and supporting colleagues, including your own growth. We celebrate different ways of thinking and welcome those who see the world differently - your unique perspective will help us innovate and thrive. What We’re Looking For: Purpose-driven Partners: Individuals who bring an entrepreneurial spirit, a commitment to building businesses, delivering measurable value for clients, and supporting the growth and development of people from all backgrounds. Creative Problem Solvers: People who look beyond the obvious, embrace curiosity, and seek to understand client needs from multiple perspectives. Your ability to see challenges differently and ask thoughtful questions will be critical. Effective Originators: Team members with a disciplined approach and a track record of originating new opportunities, including successful client stories and driving significant growth in consulting over the past three years. Empathetic Relationship Builders: Those who move beyond expertise to become trusted advisors - comfortable having open, honest and courageous conversations that unlock real value and build lasting client partnerships. Industry Experts: Strong understanding of one or more industries, such as Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Pharmaceuticals, Retail, or Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG). Experience in one or more of the following areas: Advising senior leaders (C-level) and understanding the key drivers for change, especially in areas like AI, Cloud, Digital Platforms, and Cybersecurity. Shaping and executing Technology, IT or Business Strategies, with an openness to new perspectives and innovative approaches. Leading application modernisation projects, such as SAP or S4/HANA, and embracing new technologies. IT Sourcing and Cost Optimisation, support clients achieve the right strategic partnerships that deliver technology transformations at the right price, as well as how we help companies realise broader cost savings Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Gartner: Our approach is simple: Attract the best talent, empower associates to reach their full potential and create an environment where everyone has equitable access to opportunity. We champion personal and professional development celebrating the diversity of our team and promoting a culture of inclusion, belonging, well being and growth. The results? A diverse, inclusive, supportive workplace where associates can thrive. Want to find out more, and see what our Employee Resource Groups are achieving here at Gartner? Click here https://jobs.gartner.com/inclusion/ Who are we? At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world. Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities. Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here. What makes Gartner a great place to work? Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance. We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients. Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations. We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work. Gartner is the world authority on AI At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes. It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you. What do we offer? Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers. In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
