About the role: Hybrid working based in Rome or Milan About the role: Gartner’s Consulting business is an extension of Gartner’s industry-leading IT Research. From CIOs, to leaders in business and government, we help Gartner clients across enterprises translate insights into transformational actions and achieve their mission-critical priorities. Leveraging the breadth of Gartner’s resources, Consulting is growing rapidly, with unlimited potential to continue expanding our client base. Technology Strategy Consulting. We help the C-suite make the right decisions based on how technology can transform their businesses. In today’s world, a consulting firm that is “born digital”, (with the ability to directly leverage the full power of Gartner’s research and insights) has relevance to the most important strategic decisions any business will make. What you’ll do Our Consulting Associate Directors are responsible for high-level project delivery and oversight along with client relationship management. You will manage teams, and advise clients at the highest strategic level on both big-picture and tactical matters, focusing on how technology enables a wide range of business outcomes. What you’ll need: Experience within a well-regarded management consultancy in an engagement leadership capacity Experience across a range of AI and Generative AI topics, such as: AI and Generative AI strategy AI transformation programmes and enterprise adoption Large Language Models (LLMs), foundation models, multimodal AI, and AI agents Generative AI architecture, including cloud, on-premise, hybrid, and multi-model environments Knowledge of scalable, secure, responsible, and cost-effective AI solutions AI use-case identification, prioritisation, business case development, and value realisation AI operating models, governance frameworks, policies, and controls Responsible AI, including privacy, security, explainability, bias, safety, intellectual property, and regulatory compliance AI risk management, model evaluation, monitoring, and assurance Data strategy, data governance, data quality, and data readiness for AI adoption MLOps and LLMOps, including model deployment, lifecycle management, observability, and continuous improvement AI architecture and modernisation experience, including integrating Generative AI into existing applications, business processes, and customer journeys Experience evaluating an organisation’s data, technology, and AI capabilities against long-term business objectives Experience selecting and evaluating AI platforms, foundation models, technology vendors, and implementation approaches Experience developing AI roadmaps, target operating models, capability requirements, implementation plans, and transformation programmes Experience delivering AI proofs of concept and supporting the transition of solutions from experimentation into production Understanding of the organisational and workforce implications of AI, including skills, culture, operating processes, and change management Demonstrated intellectual curiosity and the ability to assist in the creative development of solutions and strategies to solve client problems An ability to be hands-on and to manage multiple client priorities simultaneously MBA or other advanced degree preferred Consulting Experience: Experience within a well-regarded management consultancy in a project delivery capacity. Prior experience in a problem-solving capacity such as a solution/technical architect or analyst preferred A consistent track record of leading people and building high-performing teams that leverage technology to drive the mission-critical priorities of commercial or government entities An ability to inspire and motivate professionals from both technical and non-technical backgrounds towards a common goal Demonstrated intellectual curiosity and the creative development of solutions and strategies to solve client problems. Must adapt Gartner frameworks and methodologies to strike at the heart of a client’s most pressing business challenges An ability to be hands-on and to manage multiple client priorities simultaneously Excellence in written and verbal communication Expertise with strategic consulting frameworks Building rapid proto-types for presentations / sales proposals Excellent people skills and customer relationship track record; Experience in developing client business relationships as part of a commercial organisation; Who are we? At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world. Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities. Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here. What makes Gartner a great place to work? Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance. We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients. Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations. We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work. Gartner is the world authority on AI At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes. It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you. What do we offer? Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers. In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring. Locations : Milano | Roma Who We Are Boston Consulting Group (BCG) is a global management consulting ﬁrm and leading advisor on business strategy, with more than 90 oﬃces in 50 countries. We partner with clients from the private, public and not-for-profit sectors in all regions to identify their highest-value opportunities, address their most critical challenges, and transform their enterprises. Our customized approach combines deep insight into the dynamics of companies and markets with close collaboration at all levels of the client organization. This ensures that our clients achieve sustainable competitive advantage, build more capable organizations, and secure lasting results. Practice Area BCG’s Tech and Digital practice area focuses on helping clients deliver competitive advantage and business superior performance through the use of data, technology and digital. Tech and Digital is the fastest growing practice at BCG and at the heart of the strategic impact we have with our clients. Our consultants and experts globally work across all industries and provide deep experience and expertise across a number of topics including Digital Transformation, Data & Digital Platforms, AI at Scale, Agile, Cybersecurity and Digitizing the Tech Function. Our Tech and Digital offer encompasses tech experts across BCG and Platinion, providing seamless multidisciplinary solutions to our clients. What You'll Do As a Principal in BCG’s Tech & Digital Advantage practice, you will lead major client relationships and complex ERP-enabled transformations, with a primary focus on SAP S/4HANA. You will work with C-suite and senior business and technology executives to define transformation agendas, shape strategic choices, and translate ambition into measurable business outcomes. You will oversee multiple workstreams and engagements, guiding multidisciplinary teams across strategy, business processes, operating models, data, technology, and AI. Beyond project delivery, you will help grow BCG’s ERP business in Italy by developing client opportunities, strengthening capabilities, and advancing our market offering. Key Responsibilities Include Advise senior executives on SAP S/4HANA strategy, modernization, and enterprise transformation. Shape end-to-end transformation agendas, business cases, governance models, and value-creation plans. Lead complex client engagements and align business, technology, and implementation priorities. Build trusted relationships with C-suite and senior business and technology leaders. Originate and develop client opportunities, proposals, and long-term relationships in the ERP market. Oversee multiple workstreams and engagements, ensuring quality, impact, and commercial outcomes. Guide Project Leaders and consulting teams, supporting high performance and professional development. Bring together BCG’s regional and global expertise to solve complex client challenges. Own and continuously evolve the Enterprise Solutions offering for the assigned industry sector, shaping the value proposition and driving the development of industry-specific assets, accelerators, process libraries, intellectual property, and methodologies, leveraging the latest market and technology innovations. What You'll Bring Digital technology is reshaping every industry, and ERP platforms sit at the center of that transformation. As a Consultant in BCG’s Tech & Digital Advantage practice, you will help leading organizations modernize their technology foundations, unlock value from enterprise data, and accelerate business transformation through SAP S/4HANA and broader ERP-enabled change. You will work with business and technology leaders to address complex strategic and operational challenges, combining technology expertise with business insight. As part of multidisciplinary teams, you will help shape and deliver end-to-end transformations that connect strategy, processes, operating models, data, and technology. You will work primarily with BCG teams and clients in Italy, collaborating with other Consultants, Project Leaders, Principals, and colleagues across the Tech & Digital Advantage practice. You will also work with teams across the wider EMC (East Mediterranean and Caspian) system and, where relevant, EMESA, bringing broader expertise and perspectives to client engagements. You Bring 15–20+ years of management consulting experience in technology, digital, ERP, or enterprise transformation. A strong track record leading large-scale ERP strategy, modernization, and transformation programs. Deep knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, with Microsoft Dynamics or comparable ERP experience also relevant. Experience applying AI, generative AI, advanced analytics, or emerging technologies to improve enterprise processes and business performance. Proven success owning senior client relationships and influencing C-suite business and technology leaders. Demonstrated business-development experience, including opportunity shaping, proposal leadership, and commercial growth. Experience leading multiple complex engagements and developing senior consulting teams. In addition to consulting experience, previous client-side experience in roles such as Business Owner, Process Owner, or Product Owner, with direct involvement in leading or playing a key role in large-scale enterprise transformation programs, would be highly valued. Outstanding academic achievement, together with excellent written and verbal communication skills in Italian and English. Professional Skills Exceptional analytical and structured problem-solving skills. Strong ability to define transformation agendas and translate strategy into execution. Deep expertise in ERP strategy, operating-model design, process transformation, data, and technology. Proven leadership across large, multidisciplinary consulting engagements. Strong commercial capabilities and experience developing new client opportunities. Excellent executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, and persuasion skills. Ability to influence senior decision-makers and build lasting client relationships. Strong judgment in managing complex delivery, commercial, and organizational risks. Personal Attributes Collaborative and inclusive leader who brings out the best in others. Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong focus on client impact and business growth. Confident and credible when working with senior executives. Flexible, curious, and creative in addressing complex and ambiguous challenges. Strong sense of ownership and accountability for high-quality outcomes. Committed to developing Project Leaders and consulting talent. Comfortable working across cultures, markets, and organizational levels. High standards of integrity, discretion, and professionalism. Additional info Additional Info At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an essential role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development. That's why we generally operate on a hybrid model, with office presence shaped by business needs, team norms, and local policies and practices. We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork. Compensation Information Total compensation for this role includes base salary and a benefits package described below. Our Reward Philosophy is to take a holistic approach to offer a comprehensive package which includes market-competitive base salary and benefits that can support both physical and mental health. Our philosophy drives our actions and aims at being competitive, fair and easy for employees to understand. We are committed to ensuring that BCG is the best place for you to thrive and grow. The annual base salary for this role is at least EUR 145.000. Employees may also be eligible for an annual discretionary performance bonus. BCG offers a best-in-class benefits package designed to provide comprehensive care and meaningful support to you and your family. Benefits may vary based on role, contract type, and eligibility criteria. Our Benefits Include Health insurance: comprehensive medical coverage for employees with the option to extend coverage to eligible family members. Meal vouchers and corporate discounts: daily meal allowance and access to a range of partner discounts. Report this job About The Role PLEASE NOTE: this position is based in our Swiss HQ in Mendrisio, Switzerland, which is 7km over the border from Italy and easily commutable from Milan, Como, Varese or Lugano. We are also happy to assist with your relocation to this beautiful part of Europe, and we have a hybrid working policy. About The Role We are looking for an experienced and creative Senior Product Manager to join one of our Product & Engineering divisions. You’ll be part of a cross-functional team composed of around 10 engineers, a Product Designer, an Engineering Manager, and a Product & Engineering Lead. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and is passionate about building impactful products in the education and skills development space. You’ll work closely with engineering, design, marketing, and sales to shape the product vision and drive execution. You’ll also be a key contributor to the division’s strategy, helping to align product initiatives with business goals and customer needs. What You’ll Do Drive product discovery collaborating with users, engineers, and designers to identify problems, validate ideas, and shape solutions before development begins. Contribute to product strategy and planning in close collaboration with others Product Managers and the Product & Engineering Leadership. Engage with users and stakeholders to gather insights, validate ideas, and ensure the product delivers real value. Drive cross-functional collaboration, ensuring alignment across engineering, design, marketing, and sales. Analyze product performance and user behavior to inform decisions and optimize outcomes. Communicate clearly and regularly with leadership and peers to share progress, challenges, and learnings. What We’re Looking For 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in SaaS (Enterprise or Consumer). 2+ years of experience in building SaaS Enterprise/Consumer solutions Proven ability to define, deliver, and iterate on successful products. Strong technical understanding and familiarity with modern software development practices. Excellent communication, presentation, and analytical skills. Deep customer empathy and the ability to balance diverse stakeholder perspectives. Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels—from roadmap planning to writing specs. Experience building and shipping products powered by LLMs, including defining how to measure and improve the quality of AI outputs is a strong plus. Fluent in spoken and written English. Nice to Have Experience in edtech, skills development, or learning platforms. Background in UX research or design thinking. BS/MS in a technical field (Computer Engineering is a strong plus). Familiarity with data analytics tools About Us Why Join Us? Be part of a mission-driven team shaping the future of learning. Work in a collaborative division led by a Product & Engineering Lead who values ownership and impact. Enjoy a flexible work environment with opportunities for growth. Fincons Group is an IT business consulting company that has been designing the digital future of leading companies on international markets for 40 years. Fincons Group built its reputation on foreseeing and interpreting new business models and the rapid evolution of IT systems by building a complete range of services: from research and consulting to design and development, from system integration of leading vendor software solutions right up to application management, supporting clients step by step along their digital transformation journey. Fincons is a multinational with over 2,600 people and several offices worldwide (in Italy, Switzerland, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Belgium and the USA), but above all, a Family Company where the founders play a strategic role with commitment and passion, grounding the company in the same principles of a united and caring family. We firmly believe in the value of cooperation and in the contribution that every idea and intuition can bring. We believe that everyone’s effort can make a difference. Transforming knowledge into a strategic resource is our company mission, and we pursue it with the help of our most strategic asset: our people. While maintaining a strong technical involvement in the development process, you will also contribute to requirements gathering, solution design, release planning and stakeholder management You will be responsible for writing clean, scalable, and maintainable code and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver robust mobile applications. title: CRM Application Engineer

testo_completo:
CRM Application Engineer
lastminute.com group
Sede: Chiasso, Ticino, Svizzera
Join lastminute.com as a CRM Application Engineer in Switzerland. Be part of a dynamic team enhancing travel experiences for millions! Tasks Oversee growth and optimization of our CRM landscape. Manage integration and maintenance of CRM tools and workflows. Evaluate platform performance for continuous improvement opportunities. Skills Minimum 3 years in a CRM-centric technical role required. Strong analytical skills and problem-solving capabilities. Experience with SQL, scripting, and software development. CRM Application Engineer Full-time Department: Technology Compensation: CHF 47,000 - CHF 52,000 - yearly Company Description At lastminute.com, we live for the holidays. We are the European Travel-Tech leader in Dynamic Holiday Packages. With technology, we turn spontaneous thoughts into meaningful experiences, helping people travel the world. Job Description We are looking for a CRM Application Engineer to join our team of around 1,700 people worldwide to help us power up the traveller's journey for millions of holidaymakers. If you are passionate about technology and product development, and enjoy working in a fast-paced, international environment, keep reading, you might be the perfect fit for this role The job in brief: Job Title -  CRM Application Engineer Working model -  Hybrid (Switzerland) Team -  you will join the CRM and Channels team within the Technology department Level - Professional Location -  Chiasso, Switzerland Contract -  Permanent – Full time (36h/week) Travel time required - available to make short and sporadic trips abroad What your impact will be: As a CRM Application Engineer, you will oversee the strategic growth and optimization of our CRM landscape. You will ensure that internal and external customer service teams utilize data and automated workflows to deliver a superior experience for our travellers. Serve as the primary link between business units and technical delivery teams for CRM initiatives. Translate high-level business goals into functional technical specifications and process enhancements. Manage the configuration, maintenance, and integration of core CRM tools and automated sequences. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Uphold rigorous standards for data integrity and system reliability across every customer touchpoint. Evaluate platform performance to identify and execute on continuous improvement opportunities. Partner with cross-departmental teams to implement new functionalities and complex system integrations. Direct incident management efforts, including root-cause investigations and the resolution of technical hurdles. Qualifications Your expertise: A minimum of 3 years in a CRM-centric technical role, such as Analyst or Administrator. Experience in managing data structures, user access, and API-driven integrations. Ability to align business requirements with technical feasibility and scalable solutions. Competence in SQL and scripting. Software development background: MySQL, Javascript, CSS, HTML, PHP, React. Good analytical capacity with a focused, data-driven approach to solving problems. Communication skills, particularly in explaining complex technicalities to non-experts. Fluent English, written and spoken. Desirable: Background supporting Customer Care or Customer Success departments. Experience within agile development frameworks. Experience in configuring/managing platforms like VTENext, Salesforce or Zendesk is a plus. Knowledge of AWS infrastructure/services and GITLAB pipelines. Familiarity with AI-driven service tech and advanced automation solutions. Additional Information Perks of working with us: How we work together: An inclusive, friendly, and international environment (you’ll be working with colleagues from +10 countries and over 48 nationalities) Shorter working week (36h as full time), with a half working day on Fridays Flexible start and end of the working day, with core hours from 10:00 to 4:00 pm Possibility to work from anywhere for a period of time per year defined according to local regulations How we learn together: Fri-Yays: half a day on Friday morning with a no-meeting mandate and dedicated to deep work, personal growth, learning and training and/or focus time. Professional and managerial skills development training paths, access to e-learning platforms such as O’reilly, Udemy, Coursera (depending on the department), and to our internal platform offering bespoke training content Other perks: 2 paid days off per year for volunteering purposes Occasional social events to foster connections among colleagues Travel industry discounts and flash exclusive staff fares We support our employees through life's significant moments with leave options (e.g parental responsibilities, marriages, bereavements, relocations, etc.) in line with local laws. Wish you were here? We do, too! Selection process steps*: HR interview (30 minutes) 1st interview (1 hour): soft skills + technical knowledge + curiosity about the role. 2nd interview (30min): final meeting with the Director Offer extended (*Please note the process can slightly vary. The recruiter in charge will share more details when setting up the interview) Our commitment to celebrate diversity and generate belonging At the heart of our culture is a commitment to inclusion across race, gender, age, sexual orientation, religion, gender identity or expression, and accessibility. We strongly believe in an equal opportunity space, which is welcoming and celebrates the uniqueness of everyone who works here. We value different lived experiences and respect viewpoints, as we know unicity drives innovation. We want to make sure our people reflect the communities across the world we help travel. Eligibility criteria: By submitting your information and application, you confirm that you are legally authorised to work in the country of employment and that you do not require visa sponsorship to obtain employment visa status.
